certificate.ns_identity: for incompressible NS, -P(u.grad u)=P(u x omega); one unordered parent orbit contributes u_x x omega_y + u_y x omega_x at z=x+y
certificate.helical_projection: with repository coupling g(x,y,-z), <h_z,F_z>=2(s_x|x|-s_y|y|)conj(g)a_xa_y; direct curl/Leray pairing is checked against this coefficient
certificate.physical_work: production child-energy convention is T_e=2 Re(conj(a_z)<h_z,F_z>), hence the unordered parent orbit carries the canonical factor four
certificate.native_capacity: A_e=4|z||a_x a_y a_z| is modal interaction capacity of the same physical Fourier edge; no Young norm product is substituted for it
certificate.geometry: J_e=log_+(|z|/p_top)|s_x|x|-s_y|y|| |g_e|/|z| and m_e=J_e/J_* with the global sign-exhausted single-edge J_*
certificate.phase: c_e=sign(s_x|x|-s_y|y|) Re(conj(a_z)conj(g)a_xa_y)/(|g a_x a_y a_z|) lies in [-1,1]
certificate.registration: exact signed identity T_e log_+(|z|/p_top)=A_e J_e c_e on the same physical event; backscatter is retained before positive Hahn restriction
certificate.orientation: swapping the two parent orientations changes both the signed frequency factor and Waleffe g sign, leaving source, work, capacity, J and c invariant
certificate.gauge: reciprocal phase changes of helical bases and modal amplitudes leave c_e and the physical edge identity invariant
certificate.scale: uniform wavevector dilation leaves J_e, m_e, c_e and forward ratio invariant while both T_e and A_e scale linearly
certificate.scope: this is one physical Fourier/helical edge registration theorem only; it does not yet construct the continuum edge measure, prove a low-deficit block, or identify every generic HH event with signed-good generation
